recent_posts.title: GPT Image 2 review and storyboard to animation workflow
recent_posts.summary: OpenAI released GPT Image 2 on April 21, bringing major improvements including reliable multilingual text rendering, better instruction following, 4K resolution output, and reasoning-before-rendering for more consistent results. A practical workflow is demonstrated combining GPT Image 2 for storyboard generation with Seedance 2.0 for animation, plus a cyberpunk RPG-style content creator workflow using Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Seedance 2.0, and DaVinci Resolve. DALL-E 2 and DALL-E 3 are being retired on May 12, 2026. Sample image and video prompts are included for creative experimentation.

recent_posts.title: Building an AI image and video generation workflow inside VS Code with Claude Code
recent_posts.summary: A practical walkthrough of building an AI image and video generation workflow entirely inside VS Code using Claude Code. The setup involves installing the Claude Code extension, creating custom skills (/prompt-gen and /ai-generate), routing API calls through kie.ai to access 66+ models, and having generated assets download directly into a project folder. Also covers Seedance 2.0's new multi-modal capabilities, its Hollywood-driven restrictions on human face generation, and how it compares to Kling 3.0 for creative workflows. Includes example image and video prompts, plus a roundup of recent AI tool picks.

recent_posts.title: The four layers that actually make AI video work
recent_posts.summary: A practical framework for writing effective AI video prompts, covering four layers beyond standard image prompts: opening frame, motion description, camera behavior, and pacing/duration. Includes example prompts, a roundup of current AI video tools (Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Seedance 2.0, Runway 4.5), and news about OpenAI shutting down Sora due to unsustainable costs — $1M/day to run with only $2.1M in lifetime revenue.

recent_posts.title: Midjourney V8 alpha overview with style tools and prompting tips
recent_posts.summary: Midjourney V8 is now available on the alpha platform at alpha.midjourney.com. Key improvements include ~5x faster generation, native 2K resolution via --hd flag, better prompt comprehension for colors/lighting/textures, and improved in-image text rendering. Three core style tools are highlighted: Style Creator (builds custom --sref codes through iterative image selection), --sref (style references from existing images), and Moodboards (blending multiple references). Style references now default to --sv 7, which is 4x faster and cheaper. Best practices include using detailed descriptive prompts, enabling personalization with --stylize 1000, and using --raw for photorealistic output. A prompt template is provided for getting started.

recent_posts.title: Cinematic Prompting Without IP
recent_posts.summary: A practical guide to writing AI image prompts without referencing copyrighted film or animation styles like 'Blade Runner' or 'Studio Ghibli.' Instead of using IP shorthand, the approach breaks down each style into its actual visual components: lighting, lens choice, color palette, texture, and composition. Two prompt frameworks are provided: a beginner structure covering subject, description, setting, lighting, and style, and an advanced structure adding lens specs, action, atmosphere, color direction, mood, and technical detail. Three before-and-after prompt examples demonstrate how the advanced approach produces more controlled, specific results.

recent_posts.title: Kling 3.0 launches with character consistency and native audio for AI video generation
recent_posts.summary: Kling 3.0 introduces major advances in AI video generation with character consistency across shots, flexible 3-15 second video production, native audio with multi-character dialogue support, and 1080p output with frame control. The update includes enhanced image generation with series mode, improved photorealistic rendering through Deep-Stack technology, and legible text output. Testing across 100+ prompts demonstrated reliable character consistency, natural camera movements, convincing environmental physics, and proper cinematic framing. The release is currently in early access for Ultra subscribers with general rollout planned soon.

recent_posts.title: Midjourney releases Niji v7 & an interview with Google
recent_posts.summary: Midjourney launched Niji v7, a specialized anime-focused AI image generation model with improved coherence, prompt understanding, text rendering, and style reference performance. The update features a flatter aesthetic emphasizing anime linework over 3D rendering. The newsletter also covers an interview with Google's Flow team about AI video generation, a joint announcement between Apple and Google, Freepik's prompt editor tool, and includes various image and video generation prompts for different AI tools.

recent_posts.title: Advanced AI image editing with FLUX Kontext Dev and Higgsfield Soul
recent_posts.summary: FLUX.1 Kontext Dev enables precise in-context image editing with remarkable accuracy for scene transformations like relighting. Higgsfield Soul offers professional-grade text-to-image generation with over 50 curated presets and inpainting capabilities. These tools represent a shift toward giving creators more granular control over AI-generated content, moving beyond basic generation to sophisticated editing workflows that streamline professional visual production.

recent_posts.title: Midjourney launches V1 video generation with image animation capabilities
recent_posts.summary: Midjourney launched V1 video generation, allowing users to animate existing images through auto mode or manual prompting with motion control. The system offers image-to-motion capabilities with extensions up to 20 seconds. Meanwhile, MiniMax released Hailuo 02 with improved motion dynamics and 1080p output, while Higgsfield introduced Canvas for precise video editing control. Additional updates include Freepik adding Google Veo 3 and Hailuo 02, Adobe's Firefly mobile app launch, and new tools from ElevenLabs, Runway, and Krea.

recent_posts.title: Creating ad-style visuals with ChatGPT 4o
recent_posts.summary: Explore the capabilities of ChatGPT 4o for creating high-quality, customizable ad-style images and videos. Learn how to use prompts and tools like Krea GPT Paint for editing, and discover new AI advancements globally, along with top picks in AI tool capabilities.
